Class Table

java.lang.Object
com.articulate.delphi.Table
public class Table extends Object
A class that encrypts a string and checks it against another stored encrypted string, in order to validate a user login.

  • Field Details

    • username

      public String username
      The username who owns the table.

    • rows

      public HashMap rows
      A HashMap of HashMap(s), which are the columns. The decision string are the keys of the rows and the criteria string are the keys of the columns. The interior HashMap(s) have integers of range 0-10 as their values, coded as Strings.

    • columnWeights

      public HashMap columnWeights
      A HashMap of criteria string keys and string importance weight values, which are integers between 0 and 10, represented as Strings.

      public String toHTML(boolean readOnly, String projectName, TableAverage average)
      Generate an HTML table from the "rows" variable in this class. If the option is for a readOnly table, just show the table values as text, otherwise, make them a menu with the stored value as the selected option.
